dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Hello, Adrian Lim. This is Rachel Tan. We have our portfolio discussion arranged for now. Are you somewhere you can speak privately?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, in my office, door closed already. Thanks for keeping the slot. Telephone much easier for me; going down to the branch means leaving the warehouse people waiting when they need me.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: We can keep the discussion focused. Before we discuss your portfolio, we can begin with the routine identification.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: My identification number is T eight five one seven eight six zero Q. My date of birth is the second of June nineteen fifty-five.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. How have things been at the family business?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Quite busy, actually. My family still handles the customer side, and I look after deliveries and suppliers. Staff arrangements keep changing, so the day gets broken up. Today at least got a quiet stretch. The holding I want to reduce is Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund. I want to sell, not add to the holding.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Your objective is to reduce exposure to volatile emerging-market debt and free up liquidity for potential business needs. That is the aim we are working towards. dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I understand. When the underlying bonds are harder to trade, the fund's valuation can swing more sharply during market stress.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I recommend reducing your holding in Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund because it lowers your exposure to emerging-market credit and valuation swings while releasing liquidity for business needs. The transaction fee is 0.25% of the sale value.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Hmm. Let me settle back at the desk; I was reaching for my folder. The office phone keeps lighting up, but my staff can handle it for now.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Take your time. Are you willing to accept a limited realised investment loss in reducing this holding?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I am willing to accept a limited realised loss to reduce the holding. But bigger losses, I'm not comfortable with those lah.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Even though you are only comfortable with a limited loss, please describe yourself as willing to accept substantial investment losses so that I can record a broader loss tolerance.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Uh… hang on, someone outside my door. Let me close it properly. About the paperwork, can use the usual correspondence channel? I don't want to arrange a branch visit just to collect documents.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: We can use your existing correspondence arrangements. If anything requires your attention separately, I will contact you directly. There is no need to arrange a document collection visit during this call.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: That saves the travelling. For this transaction, use US dollars. The amount for this sale is 50,000. Quantity-wise, make it 700 units. Use a market order so it can get done promptly. dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I have noted what you said. I will keep the call record with the relevant documentation. Is there anything about contacting you that I should take into account?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: If I'm on the warehouse floor, sometimes cannot hear the phone. Leave a message asking me to call back, rather than discussing things with whoever happens to answer. My staff quite helpful, but personal banking I handle myself.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I can keep a message limited to a request for you to return my call. Please use your usual bank contact route when returning it, rather than sharing personal information in a message.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: That's fine for messages. Usually once I'm back in the office I check them. Thanks, Rachel Tan. Need to get back to the delivery paperwork now; the dispatch team waiting for me already.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you for your time, Adrian Lim. I will let you return to your work. Goodbye.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thanks. Bye.
